title: Sartor Resartus: The Life and Opinions of Herr Teufelsdröckh
sourceTitle: Sartor Resartus: The Life and Opinions of Herr Teufelsdröckh
author: Thomas Carlyle
description: "Sartor Resartus: The Life and Opinions of Herr Teufelsdröckh" by Thomas Carlyle is a novel first serialized between 1833-1834.
longDescription: A skeptical English Editor attempts to review a bewildering German philosophy book about clothes by the fictional Professor Diogenes Teufelsdröckh. When the Editor requests biographical information to make sense of the philosopher's Transcendentalist musings, he receives only bags of paper scraps.

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Carlyle was a Scottish essayist, historian and philosopher. Known as the "sage of Chelsea", his writings strongly influenced the intellectual and artistic culture of the Victorian era.
